tldr: Fed官員偏鴿使12月降息機率回升至約七成，台股季線附近震盪盤堅。
AI需求續旺，台積電10月營收創高、PCB與ABF載板進入多年上升循環。
金管會推進數位金融與資產管理政策，預告穩定幣草案並力推台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心。

items.title_zh: Fed官員挺降息、12月降息機率回升至七成，台股季線震盪盤堅（2026-11-24）
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks steady near quarterly line as Fed rate-cut odds rebound
items.summary_zh: 多位Fed官員對降息表態偏鴿，使市場預期12月美國降息機率回升至約七成，激勵台股開盤前氣氛轉穩。法人研判大盤可望在季線附近獲得支撐、以震盪盤堅格局整理，權值股與AI供應鏈仍是資金觀察重點，後續須留意外資買賣超動向。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Monday's open, Taiwan equities were seen holding around quarterly moving-average support after dovish Fed comments pushed market-implied odds of a December US rate cut back up to roughly 70%. Analysts expect a range-bound, consolidating session, with heavyweight chipmakers and the AI supply chain remaining the focus of fund flows.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報大幅優於預期，台股AI供應鏈吹反攻號角（2026-11-20）
items.title_en: Nvidia's forecast-beating results rekindle Taiwan AI supply-chain buying
items.summary_zh: 輝達單季財報明顯優於市場預期，點燃台股AI硬體族群買盤；盤面維持兆元成交量，投信單日加碼台積電，載板、PCB等族群在AI需求題材帶動下反彈。市場氣氛由觀望轉為偏多，惟外資態度與美股走勢仍是後續多空關鍵。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's quarterly results came in well above expectations, reigniting optimism across Taiwan's AI hardware names. Local reports described a "counter-attack" tone: trillion-dollar turnover held up and investment trusts stepped in to buy TSMC, while carrier-board and PCB makers rebounded on AI-demand momentum.

items.title_zh: 台積電10月營收創單月歷史新高，AI需求續旺（2026-11）
items.title_en: TSMC posts record October revenue as AI demand stays hot
items.summary_zh: 台積電2026年10月營收改寫單月歷史新高，顯示AI加速器與高效能運算對先進製程的需求依然強勁。市場研判先進產能緊俏態勢將延續至2027年，雲端大廠持續擴建AI基礎設施，為台積電先進製程與先進封裝業務提供長線支撐。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported its highest-ever monthly revenue for October 2026, underscoring that demand for advanced nodes tied to AI accelerators and high-performance computing remains robust. The result reinforces expectations that leading-edge capacity will stay tight into 2027 as hyperscalers keep building out AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: AI應用續強，台廠PCB與ABF載板同步受惠（2026-11）
items.title_en: AI boom lifts Taiwan PCB and ABF substrate makers
items.summary_zh: 台系電路板廠看好高階AI應用需求：臻鼎第三季營收創單季新高，欣興預估AI營收占比下半年上看七成，華立則表示ABF載板供需缺口將延續至2028年。業者普遍認為AI伺服器帶動的載板、PCB上升循環可望延續多年，產業基本面維持強勁。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese circuit-board suppliers flagged sustained strength in high-end AI applications: Zhen Ding reported record quarterly revenue, Unimicron guided AI toward about 70% of revenue in 2H26, and Wah Lee said the ABF substrate supply-demand gap will persist through 2028. The comments point to a multi-year upcycle driven by AI servers.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法草案（2026-11-03）
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces draft rules for stablecoin issuance
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法草案，建立以許可制為核心的發行人監理架構，並同步預告修正金融機構洗錢防制相關規定。此舉象徵台灣對與數位資產連結之支付工具將納入更明確法制，未來發行穩定幣須取得主管機關許可，並符合風控與防制洗錢要求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission released a draft of its stablecoin issuance licensing and management regulations, setting out a permit-based framework for issuers. Alongside it, the FSC proposed amendments tightening anti-money-laundering requirements for financial institutions, signaling a more formal regime for digital-asset-linked payments.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准富邦銀首爾辦事處升格分行（2026-11-10）
items.title_en: FSC clears Fubon's Seoul office upgrade to a full branch
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意台北富邦商業銀行首爾代表人辦事處升格為分行，擴大其在南韓市場布局；同時修正地方資產管理專區試辦業務作業原則。主管機關持續引導銀行拓展海外據點與特定專業業務，有助國銀強化區域金融服務與資產管理能量。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved Taipei Fubon Commercial Bank's application to upgrade its Seoul representative office into a branch, expanding the bank's footprint in South Korea. The regulator also revised operating principles for the local distressed-asset (AMC) pilot zone, part of ongoing efforts to broaden banks' overseas and specialized-business reach.

items.title_zh: 全球ETF規模逼近24兆美元，可望超越共同基金（2026-11-12）
items.title_en: Global ETF assets near $24tn, on track to pass mutual funds
items.summary_zh: Direxion執行長於11月論壇指出，截至9月底全球ETF資產規模約24兆美元，並預期美國ETF資產可望於2027年初超越共同基金；亞太資產管理規模年複合成長率6.8%居全球之冠。顯示ETF在高資產與一般投資人資產配置中的角色持續擴大，為財管業務成長主軸之一。
items.summary_en: At a November forum, Direxion's CEO noted global ETF assets reached roughly $24tn as of end-September and projected US ETF assets could overtake mutual funds by early 2027. Asia-Pacific asset management is growing fastest worldwide at a 6.8% CAGR, highlighting ETFs' expanding role across high-net-worth and retail portfolios.

items.title_zh: 金管會推動台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心（2026-11-18）
items.title_en: Regulator pushes Taiwan as an Asian asset-management hub
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆在經濟日報論壇重申，將積極打造台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心，並推動ETF邁向國際化。政策方向鎖定吸引高資產與法人資金、深化本地基金生態系，為銀行與投信投顧的財富管理業務開拓中長期成長動能，亦呼應高資產客群規模持續擴張趨勢。
items.summary_en: FSC Chairman Peng Jin-long reiterated plans to develop Taiwan into an Asian asset-management center, including internationalizing its ETF market, at an economic forum. The agenda aims to attract high-net-worth and institutional flows and deepen the local fund ecosystem, supporting banks' and asset managers' wealth-management businesses.
